in_sanskrit.name: Rudal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mighty, Strong, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rudal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rudal is a powerful and mighty name derived from the Sanskrit word Rudh, which means 'to cry out or roar'. This name is associated with strength, courage, and the power to overcome challenges.
